description: Project scaffolding, database schema design with Prisma, and backend API foundation. This feature establishes the complete project structure including: monorepo setup with TypeScript, Prisma schema with all entities from the legacy system (multi-tenant architecture with companies, units, users, permissions, students, enrollments, grades, attendance, internships, requests, financial records, etc.), Express.js backend with authentication (JWT + refresh tokens), base middleware, and route structure for all modules.
steps: Create the /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/ directory with package.json configured for TypeScript, Express.js, Prisma, Next.js, and all necessary dependencies
Create tsconfig.json with appropriate TypeScript configuration for both backend and frontend

Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/prisma/schema.prisma with the complete database schema including: Tenant (empresa), Unit (unidade), User (usuario), Permission/Role (permissao/perfil), Course (curso), Class (turma), Discipline (disciplina), Student (aluno), Enrollment (matricula), Grade (nota), Attendance (frequencia/chamada), DiaryEntry (diario), Internship (estagio), Request (requerimento), Minutes (ata), FinancialRecord (financeiro), FinancialPayment (mensalidade/parcela), AuditLog (auditoria). All entities must support multi-tenant isolation, audit trails, and soft-delete patterns.
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/backend/server.ts as the Express.js entry point with CORS, body-parser, error handling middleware
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/backend/config/ with environment configuration, database connection, and JWT settings

Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/backend/middleware/ with authentication middleware (JWT verification), authorization middleware (role-based), audit logging middleware, and error handling middleware

Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/backend/routes/ with route files for all modules: auth.routes.ts, cadastros.routes.ts, matriculas.routes.ts, notas.routes.ts, diario.routes.ts, estagios.routes.ts, requerimentos.routes.ts, atas.routes.ts, financeiro.routes.ts, pesquisa.routes.ts, relatorios.routes.ts, movimentacao.routes.ts, utilitarios.routes.ts
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/backend/controllers/ with controller stubs for each module
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/backend/utils/ with helper utilities (pagination, response formatters, validators)
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/shared/types/ with shared TypeScript interfaces and types
Implement the authentication system: POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/auth/refresh, POST /api/auth/logout with JWT + refresh token pattern
Implement complete CRUD for Cadastros (basic registrations) module: courses, classes, disciplines, teachers, students with full REST API endpoints
Implement complete CRUD for Matriculas (enrollments) module: create enrollment, renew, transfer, cancel, suspend with full REST API endpoints
Add Jest test configuration and write basic tests for authentication and CRUD operations
acceptance_criteria: Running 'npm install' in /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/ succeeds without errors
Running 'npx prisma validate' succeeds, confirming the schema is valid
Running 'npx prisma generate' succeeds, generating the Prisma client
Running 'npm run build' compiles TypeScript without errors
Running 'npm test' passes all unit tests for authentication and CRUD endpoints
The Prisma schema contains at minimum 15 models representing all major entities of the legacy system
The API has working authentication endpoints (login, refresh, logout) with JWT
The Cadastros module has full CRUD REST API endpoints (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) for at least 3 entity types
The Matriculas module has REST API endpoints for enrollment lifecycle (create, renew, transfer, cancel)
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app && npm install' and confirm success
Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app && npx prisma validate' and confirm valid schema
Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app && npx prisma generate' and confirm client generation
Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app && npm run build' and confirm zero compilation errors
Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app && npm test' and confirm all tests pass
